This clove is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in deciduous or mixed forests, and is best known throughout Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains routine to find.

The usable parts of Thurl yield a decoction that restores 1–4 concussion hits. The prepared remedy keeps for one to two weeks. The plant is easy to find in cool temperate woodland, making it an everyday aid rather than an exceptional resource.
